0.$description: No rounding. Mirrors Figma’s semantic radius 0.

subtle.$description: 2px. Hairline rounding for fine details and edge cases (focus rings, inline highlights).

control.$description: 4px. Standard rounding for interactive controls: buttons, inputs, tags.

container.$description: 8px. Rounding for passive surfaces: cards, panels, notices, dialogs.

expressive.$description: 16px. High-curvature for feature callouts and special moments.
